program.name: Doctoral-Track Major in Finance, Economics & Quantitative Markets

tiers.name: Foundations
tiers.standard: Rigorous first-two-years university mathematics, computing, statistics and economics.

tiers.name: Major
tiers.standard: Complete undergraduate finance major at a top program, plus the quantitative depth most majors skip.

tiers.name: Master's
tiers.standard: MFE / MSF / MSc Economics level: continuous-time finance, econometrics, and production research.

tiers.name: Doctoral
tiers.standard: First-year PhD coursework in asset pricing, econometrics and macro, then original research.

tracks.name: Corporate Finance / Investment Banking / Private Equity
Research doctorate (minimum prerequisite path to thesis)

modules.title: How to Study This Program
modules.core: Evidence grades (T/A/B/C/D/X); how to read a paper (question, identification, data, inference, robustness); steelmanning; the project ladder; how Atlas compounds; the notation conventions.
introduces: Anatomy of a paper: question, identification, data, inference, robustness
Identification (the variation that pins down an estimate)
Verified citation registry and citation keys

project.title: Paper teardown
project.brief: Take one assigned classic paper and produce a one-page structured teardown: question, mechanism, data, identification, main result with its locator, the weakest assumption, and the evidence grade it deserves.

modules.title: Diagnostics, Mastery Gating & Spaced Retrieval
modules.core: How placement tests let you skip what you already know; mastery thresholds; the spaced-retrieval scheduler; interleaved review; why rereading is a weak strategy and retrieval is a strong one.

project.title: Personal study plan
project.brief: From your placement results and the track hour totals, build a dated study plan covering weekly hours, track choice, review cadence and milestones.

modules.title: Precalculus & Mathematical Reasoning
modules.core: Algebra, functions, exponentials and logarithms (continuous compounding), sequences and series (annuities, perpetuities), sets, quantifiers, direct proof, contradiction, induction.
introduces: Compounding frequency and the effective annual rate

project.title: Annuity and mortgage engine
project.brief: Derive the closed forms for annuity, perpetuity and growing-perpetuity values by induction and geometric series, then implement and test them, including a full amortization schedule.

modules.title: Single & Multivariable Calculus
modules.core: Limits, derivatives, Taylor's theorem, integration, partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians, Hessians, multiple integrals, implicit-function and envelope theorems.

project.title: Sensitivity engine
project.brief: Build first- and second-order sensitivities for any differentiable pricing function, using analytic, finite-difference and automatic-differentiation approaches, and characterize where finite differences break.

modules.title: Linear Algebra
modules.core: Vector spaces, linear maps, eigendecomposition, spectral theorem, SVD, positive-semidefinite matrices, projections, least-squares geometry, PCA.
introduces: Level, slope and curvature factors of the yield curve

project.title: Covariance-matrix doctor
project.brief: Diagnose and repair non-PSD empirical correlation matrices (nearest-correlation projection, eigenvalue clipping). Compare the effect of each repair on downstream portfolio weights.

modules.title: Probability
modules.core: Distributions, expectation, MGFs and characteristic functions, the multivariate normal, conditioning, LLN, CLT, heavy tails, and the failure of the CLT under infinite variance.
introduces: Failure of the CLT under infinite variance (stable limits)

project.title: Tail-risk simulator
project.brief: Simulate portfolio losses under multivariate Gaussian vs. multivariate Student-t returns with matched covariance. Quantify how the 99% loss estimate changes, and prove the moment conditions behind the result.

modules.title: Real Analysis
modules.core: Completeness of R, sequences and series, continuity, uniform convergence, compactness, metric spaces, fixed-point theorems (Banach), Riemann–Stieltjes.
introduces: Contraction property of the discounted Bellman operator
Value-function iteration with a certified error bound

project.title: Contraction-mapping solver
project.brief: Prove the Bellman operator for a discounted savings problem is a contraction, then implement value-function iteration with a certified error bound.

modules.title: Measure-Theoretic Probability
modules.core: Sigma-algebras, Lebesgue integral, MCT and DCT, Fubini, Radon–Nikodym, conditional expectation as L2 projection, filtrations, discrete-time martingales, optional stopping, martingale convergence.
introduces: Conditional expectation as an L2 projection

project.title: Proof portfolio: martingales
project.brief: Write complete proofs of optional stopping (bounded case), Doob's maximal inequality, and the martingale convergence theorem, then verify each numerically on simulated paths.

modules.title: Optimization
modules.core: Convex sets and functions, Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, duality, quadratic programming, dynamic programming and the Bellman equation.
introduces: Mean-variance optimization as a quadratic program

project.title: Constrained allocator
project.brief: Build a mean-variance allocator supporting box, turnover and sector constraints. Verify the KKT conditions hold at every returned solution.

modules.title: Numerical Methods & Scientific Computing
modules.core: IEEE 754, conditioning and stability, root finding, linear solvers, interpolation, quadrature, finite differences, random-number generation, Monte Carlo and variance reduction.
introduces: Monte Carlo integration and its root-n error
Robust implied-volatility inversion (bracketing with Newton acceleration)

project.title: Robust implied-volatility solver
project.brief: Build an implied-vol solver that never fails on valid inputs (deep ITM/OTM, near expiry), using bracketing with Newton acceleration. Stress it on a generated grid of a million inputs.

modules.title: Programming in Python from Zero
modules.core: Types, control flow, functions, data structures, classes and protocols, type hints, errors, files, modules, NumPy and pandas fundamentals.
introduces: Built-in data structures (list, dict, set, tuple)
Type hints and static type checking

project.title: Atlas A1: repository skeleton
project.brief: Create the Atlas package with typed modules, a CLI, a pytest suite, formatting and linting config, and CI. Every later Atlas milestone builds on this repository.

modules.title: Algorithms & Data Structures
modules.core: Complexity, arrays, hash maps, heaps, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, dynamic programming, and the data structures behind order books and event queues.
introduces: Comparison sorting and its lower bound
Order-book data structure (price levels with FIFO queues)
Monotonic deque for rolling minimum and maximum

project.title: Streaming statistics library
project.brief: Implement O(1)-update rolling mean, variance (Welford), min/max (monotonic deque) and an approximate quantile sketch. Prove the correctness of Welford's update.

modules.title: Data, Databases & SQL
modules.core: The relational model, SQL, joins, window functions, ASOF joins, indexing, columnar storage, Parquet, DuckDB.
introduces: Data manifest (source, licence, retrieval time, hash)

project.title: Atlas A2: data layer
project.brief: Build the Atlas data layer: a DuckDB store with a point-in-time schema, ingestion for FRED, French, Shiller, Treasury and EDGAR, and a manifest with source, licence, retrieval time and hash.

modules.title: Software Engineering & Reproducible Research
modules.core: Git workflows, testing (unit, property-based, regression), typing, packaging, CI, environment pinning, determinism, code review.

project.title: Reproducibility audit
project.brief: Take a deliberately broken research repository (unpinned, non-deterministic, no tests) and make it reproduce bit-for-bit, documenting every fix.

modules.title: C++ & Systems for Finance
modules.core: Modern C++ (C++20): value semantics, RAII, templates, the STL, memory hierarchy, cache effects, compilation, Python bindings, WASM compilation.
introduces: Standard Template Library containers and algorithms

project.title: C++ Monte Carlo kernel
project.brief: Port a Python Monte Carlo pricer to C++ with identical seeded output, expose it to Python, and document the speedup and where it comes from.

modules.title: Parallel & High-Performance Computing
modules.core: Amdahl's law, threads vs. processes, SIMD, GPU programming model, parallel RNG streams, profiling, latency vs. throughput engineering.

project.title: Parallel risk run
project.brief: Parallelize a full-portfolio Monte Carlo VaR with reproducible RNG streams, achieving a measured speedup and reconciling the result to the serial run.

modules.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization
modules.core: Distributions, robust summaries, outliers, missing data, stale prices and splits, graphical perception, how charts mislead.
introduces: Robust summary statistics (median, MAD, trimmed mean)
Corporate-action break in a price series

project.title: Atlas A3: data-quality reports
project.brief: Add automated profiling to Atlas, flagging gaps, outliers, stale prints and corporate-action breaks on any dataset in the store.

modules.title: Statistical Inference
modules.core: Estimators, bias and variance, MLE and its asymptotics, Fisher information, Cramér–Rao, hypothesis tests, power, confidence intervals, Bayesian inference, the bootstrap.
introduces: Bias, variance and mean squared error of an estimator
Standard error of the Sharpe ratio under iid returns

project.title: Power analysis for a strategy
project.brief: Compute how many years of data are needed to detect a given Sharpe ratio at a given power, analytically and by simulation, and reconcile the two.

modules.title: Linear Regression
modules.core: OLS geometry, Gauss–Markov, asymptotics, heteroskedasticity-robust and HAC errors, clustering, errors-in-variables, Stambaugh bias in predictive regressions.

project.title: Inference engine
project.brief: Implement OLS with classical, White, Newey–West and two-way clustered standard errors, validated against statsmodels and by simulated coverage rates.

modules.title: Time Series
modules.core: Stationarity, ARMA, Wold, unit roots, spurious regression, cointegration, VARs and identification, state space and the Kalman filter, Markov switching.

project.title: Pairs-trading audit
project.brief: Test claimed cointegrated pairs on open data with correct critical values, measure half-life stability out of sample, and show how many pairs survive.

modules.title: Volatility Econometrics
modules.core: ARCH, GARCH, EGARCH, realized volatility, HAR, forecast evaluation (QLIKE, MSE).
introduces: Loss functions robust to a noisy volatility proxy

project.title: Atlas A4: time-series toolkit
project.brief: Add ARMA, GARCH, HAR and Kalman estimators to Atlas, with robust loss-function-based forecast evaluation.

modules.title: GMM & Cross-Sectional Econometrics
modules.core: GMM theory and efficient weighting, Fama–MacBeth, Shanken correction, the GRS test, panel fixed effects.

project.title: Two-pass estimator with errors-in-variables correction
project.brief: Implement Fama–MacBeth with Shanken-corrected standard errors and GMM equivalents, and show when the correction changes the conclusion.

modules.title: Causal Inference & Event Studies
modules.core: Potential outcomes, IV and weak instruments, difference-in-differences (including staggered adoption), RDD, event studies, synthetic control.
introduces: Staggered adoption and two-way fixed-effects bias

project.title: Policy-shock event study
project.brief: Measure asset-price reactions to a set of scheduled macro announcements using open data, with clustering-robust inference and placebo dates.

modules.title: Research Integrity & Multiple Testing
modules.core: Data snooping, the Reality Check, SPA, Romano–Wolf, FDR, the factor-zoo t-stat hurdle, the deflated Sharpe ratio, probability of backtest overfitting, p-hacking.
introduces: Repeated significance testing (peeking) and its type I error inflation
Empirical Bayes shrinkage of many Sharpe ratios
Expected maximum Sharpe ratio of N null strategies
Diebold–Mariano test of equal predictive accuracy
Hansen's test for superior predictive ability (SPA)
p-hacking and the garden of forking paths
Minimum Bayes factor and the Bayesianized p-value
Sharpe-ratio variance under skewness and kurtosis
Test of equal Sharpe ratios for two strategies on the same periods

project.title: Atlas A8: research-integrity module
project.brief: Add deflated Sharpe, PBO, Romano–Wolf and BH adjustments to Atlas as one integrity report computed from a backtest's full trial set, ready for the backtester (A9) to attach to every result it returns; then use it to write an integrity memo to an investment committee on a real currency-momentum grid (Federal Reserve H.10 spot rates), graded by rubric against annotated exemplars.

modules.title: Microeconomics
modules.core: Consumer and producer theory, demand and supply, elasticity, market structures, welfare, externalities, public goods.
introduces: Price elasticity of demand and supply

project.title: Market-structure lab
project.brief: Model an exchange-fee market under monopoly vs. Cournot vs. Bertrand competition, and quantify the welfare and fee outcomes.

modules.title: Game Theory & Information Economics
modules.core: Nash and Bayesian-Nash equilibrium, adverse selection, signaling, screening, moral hazard, mechanism design, auctions.

project.title: Treasury auction design
project.brief: Simulate uniform-price vs. discriminatory auctions with strategic bidders and compare revenue, bid shading and allocative efficiency.

modules.title: Decision Theory Under Risk & Ambiguity
modules.core: Expected utility, Arrow–Pratt risk aversion, stochastic dominance, Epstein–Zin recursive preferences, prospect theory, ambiguity aversion.
introduces: Arrow–Pratt absolute and relative risk aversion

project.title: Preference elicitation
project.brief: Design and run an in-page lottery questionnaire, estimate the participant's risk-aversion and loss-aversion parameters by MLE, and report the uncertainty.

modules.title: General Equilibrium & Information in Markets
modules.core: Arrow–Debreu, complete vs. incomplete markets, rational expectations, the Grossman–Stiglitz paradox, the no-trade theorem.

project.title: Price-informativeness model
project.brief: Solve a noisy rational-expectations model numerically, and show how price informativeness responds to noise-trader volume and information cost.

modules.title: Macroeconomics I: Aggregates, Cycles & Policy
modules.core: National accounts, growth accounting, the Solow model, IS-LM and AD-AS, the Phillips curve and the natural rate, central banking and fiscal policy basics.
introduces: Fiscal policy and the fiscal multiplier

project.title: Macro dashboard v0
project.brief: Assemble GDP, inflation, unemployment, policy-rate and term-spread series from Atlas into a documented dashboard, with a one-page cycle diagnosis.

modules.title: Macroeconomics II: Dynamic General Equilibrium
modules.core: RBC, New Keynesian models, determinacy, heterogeneous-agent (HANK) models, solution and estimation methods.

project.title: NK model solver
project.brief: Solve the NK model by undetermined coefficients and numerically, verify the determinacy (Taylor) principle, and reproduce the canonical impulse responses.

modules.title: Monetary Economics & Central Banking
modules.core: Policy rules, time inconsistency, the ZLB, operating frameworks (floor vs. corridor), QE channels and evidence, shock identification, r-star, the fiscal theory of the price level, the 2021–23 inflation.
introduces: Fiscal theory of the price level

project.title: Monetary-shock identification
project.brief: Construct high-frequency policy surprises from embedded futures-implied rates, estimate their effects with local projections, and compare the result with the Romer–Romer narrative series.

modules.debate: Does QE work mainly through portfolio balance or through signalling?

modules.title: International Macro & the Dollar
modules.core: Balance of payments, UIP failure, CIP deviations, the trilemma, Mundell–Fleming, Dornbusch overshooting, the dominant-currency paradigm, the global financial cycle, safe assets and convenience yields.

project.title: CIP-basis monitor
project.brief: Compute cross-currency bases from public rates and FX data, relate them to quarter-ends and dollar-funding stress, and explain the mechanism.

modules.debate: Is UIP failure a risk premium or mispricing?

modules.title: Sovereign Debt, Crises & Political Economy
modules.core: Debt dynamics and r minus g, sovereign default, currency-crisis models, sudden stops, banking crises, the Reinhart–Rogoff replication episode.
introduces: Public-debt dynamics and r minus g

project.title: Sovereign risk report
project.brief: Build a debt-sustainability analysis for one country from public data, with fan charts and a default-probability mapping, and defend it in a two-page memo.

modules.title: The Financial System, Markets & Instruments
modules.core: Money and credit creation, intermediaries, exchanges vs. OTC, instrument taxonomy across equities, rates, credit, FX, commodities and derivatives, order types, clearing and settlement.
introduces: Money and credit creation by banks
Trade lifecycle from order entry to settlement

project.title: Instrument cash-flow engine
project.brief: Represent bonds, futures, swaps and options as dated cash-flow or payoff objects with a common interface, and test each against hand-computed examples.

modules.title: Derivatives Fundamentals
modules.core: Forwards, futures, swaps, option payoffs, no-arbitrage forward pricing, put–call parity, one-period and multi-period binomial pricing, using the Black–Scholes formula.
introduces: Futures margining and marking to market
Model-free option bounds and convexity in strike

project.title: Arbitrage scanner
project.brief: Given an embedded option-chain snapshot, detect put–call parity and convexity violations net of a stated cost model, and explain each one found.

modules.title: Market Efficiency: The Evidence Primer
modules.core: The efficient-markets hypothesis and its forms, the arithmetic of active management, luck vs. skill, the anomalies preview, behavioral explanations.
introduces: Weak, semi-strong and strong forms of efficiency

project.title: Fund-skill test
project.brief: Using a simulated fund universe with known skill, show how many funds look skilled by chance, and recover the true skilled set with a bootstrap.

modules.debate: Are markets efficient? (primer; full debate in AP8 and CAP2)

modules.title: Investments & Equity Security Analysis
modules.core: Equity markets and instruments, industry and competitive analysis, the dividend discount model, FCFE and residual-income approaches, multiples, sell-side vs. buy-side research, and the evidence on analyst forecasts and recommendations.

project.title: Initiation-of-coverage report
project.brief: Write a full sell-side-format initiation on a real public company: industry and competitive analysis, an Atlas-driven model (A15/A16), a price target with bull/base/bear scenarios and probabilities, key risks, and what would change the call.

studio.title: Forensic Audit of a Public Company

modules.title: Financial Accounting
modules.core: Double-entry bookkeeping, accrual accounting, the three statements and how they link, GAAP vs. IFRS, revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15), leases (ASC 842 / IFRS 16), stock compensation, deferred taxes.

project.title: Three-statement model from raw transactions
project.brief: Post 200 generated transactions, produce balance sheet, income statement and cash-flow statement, and prove the statements articulate.

modules.title: Financial Statement Analysis & Earnings Quality
modules.core: Ratio analysis, DuPont decomposition, cash-flow quality, the accruals anomaly, earnings management, the F-score and M-score.

project.title: Atlas A15: fundamentals engine
project.brief: Ingest EDGAR XBRL into Atlas, standardize the statements across filers, and implement the ratio, accrual and score library.

modules.title: Earnings, Disclosure & Market Reaction
modules.core: Information content of earnings, post-earnings-announcement drift, disclosure and guidance, the residual-income link between accounting and value.

project.title: PEAD replication
project.brief: Replicate post-earnings-announcement drift with the student's own price data (bring-your-own-data mode) and Atlas fundamentals. Report the post-2000 decay and net-of-cost results.

modules.title: Managerial & Cost Accounting for Decisions
modules.core: Cost behaviour, contribution margin and cost-volume-profit analysis, relevant costs for decisions, activity-based costing, master and flexible budgets, variance analysis, transfer pricing, performance measurement (residual income, EVA).
introduces: Budget variance analysis (price, volume, mix, efficiency)

project.title: Budget and variance engine
project.brief: Build a master budget and a flexible budget for a seeded company case, and decompose actual-vs-budget profit into price, volume, mix and efficiency variances that reconcile exactly.

modules.title: Time Value & Capital Budgeting
modules.core: NPV, IRR and its pitfalls, payback, project cash flows, inflation and real vs. nominal, what CFOs actually do.
introduces: Multiple IRRs and NPV–IRR ranking conflicts
Fisher relation: real vs. nominal rates

project.title: Capital-budgeting engine
project.brief: Build a project-evaluation tool with tax, depreciation, working capital and real-vs-nominal handling, plus Monte Carlo NPV.

modules.title: Cost of Capital & Capital Structure
modules.core: WACC and its estimation error, Modigliani–Miller, tax shields, trade-off vs. pecking order, market timing, leverage dynamics.
introduces: Estimation error in the cost of capital

project.title: Cost-of-capital estimation under uncertainty
project.brief: Estimate one firm's WACC with full error propagation (beta, ERP, spreads), and show the valuation range the error implies.

modules.title: Payout, Governance & Agency
modules.core: Dividends vs. buybacks, payout irrelevance and its failures, agency costs, free cash flow, boards, executive compensation, shareholder rights.
introduces: Agency costs of equity and debt

project.title: Governance scorecard
project.brief: Score ten firms on governance from proxy-statement data, and test (with honest power caveats) whether the score relates to valuation.

modules.title: Valuation
modules.core: DCF (FCFF / FCFE), terminal value, multiples, residual income, sum of the parts, real options, and the valuation errors that dominate in practice.
introduces: Free cash flow to the firm (FCFF)
DCF valuation on free cash flow to the firm
Enterprise value to equity value bridge

project.title: Atlas A16: valuation engine
project.brief: Add DCF, residual-income and multiples valuation to Atlas, driven by A15 fundamentals, with scenario and sensitivity grids.

modules.title: M&A, LBOs & Restructuring
modules.core: Takeover theory, announcement returns, synergies and overpayment, LBO mechanics and value creation, bankruptcy and Chapter 11.

project.title: LBO model
project.brief: Build a full LBO model (sources and uses, debt tranches, cash sweep, covenants, exit) with IRR/MOIC attribution, and test it for internal consistency.

modules.title: Raising Capital & Investment Banking
modules.core: IPO underpricing, long-run IPO performance, SEOs, debt issuance, bookbuilding, underwriting economics.
introduces: Underwriting economics and the gross spread

project.title: IPO pricing case
project.brief: Price a hypothetical IPO from comparables and DCF, design the book-building allocation, and explain the expected first-day return.

modules.title: Financial Modeling: Spreadsheets to Code
modules.core: Model architecture (inputs / calculations / outputs), integrated three-statement models, circularity (revolver interest), scenarios and sensitivities, error checks, the documented record of spreadsheet errors, and reconciling a spreadsheet model to an independent Python implementation.
introduces: Model integrity checks (balance check, cash tie-out, no hard-codes)
The documented risk of spreadsheet errors
Reconciling a spreadsheet to an independent implementation

project.title: Integrated three-statement + DCF model (.xlsx)
project.brief: Build an integrated three-statement model with a revolver, debt schedule and DCF in Excel, LibreOffice or Google Sheets for your seeded company case. The in-page grader (openpyxl in Pyodide) checks structure (no hard-codes in calculation blocks, balance check, cash tie-out) and the saved values against the Python reference.

modules.title: Working Capital, Treasury & Short-Term Finance
modules.core: The cash conversion cycle, receivables and credit policy, inventory, payables and supply-chain finance, cash forecasting, bank lines, commercial paper, and the evidence on corporate cash holdings.
introduces: Precautionary motive for corporate cash holdings

project.title: 13-week cash-flow forecast
project.brief: Build a 13-week direct cash forecast and liquidity plan for a stressed company case. Size the revolver, identify the covenant pinch point, and propose working-capital actions with their cash impact.

modules.title: Corporate Risk Management & International Corporate Finance
modules.core: Why firms hedge (theory and evidence), transaction / translation / economic FX exposure, hedging with forwards, options and swaps, hedge accounting basics, international capital budgeting and cost of capital, political risk.
introduces: International capital budgeting and cost of capital

project.title: Corporate hedging program
project.brief: Design an FX and interest-rate hedging program for a multinational case, simulate cash-flow-at-risk with and without the program, and write the board memo, including the hedge-accounting consequences.

modules.title: Banking & Asset-Liability Management
modules.core: Why banks exist, maturity transformation, NIM, interest-rate risk in the banking book, the deposit franchise, capital and liquidity regulation (Basel III, LCR, NSFR).

project.title: ALM engine
project.brief: Model a bank's repricing gaps, EVE and NII sensitivity, with deposit-beta assumptions made explicit and stress-tested.

modules.title: Asset Management Industry
modules.core: Mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds, fee structures, flow-performance relationships, indexing and its market effects.

project.title: Fund-economics model
project.brief: Model a fund's AUM, fees, flows and capacity under the Berk–Green mechanism, and show where investor alpha goes.

modules.title: Insurance & Pensions
modules.core: Actuarial basics, insurer balance sheets and regulation, pension funding and discount-rate choice, liability-driven investment and its 2022 failure mode.

project.title: LDI collateral-spiral model
project.brief: Model a leveraged LDI fund's collateral needs under a gilt-yield shock, find the forced-selling threshold, and evaluate the central-bank backstop.

modules.title: Payments, Market Infrastructure & Fintech
modules.core: Payment systems, clearing and settlement, CCPs and netting, T+1, stablecoins and tokenization, operational risk.
introduces: Payment systems (RTGS and deferred net settlement)

project.title: Clearing-house simulator
project.brief: Simulate a CCP default waterfall (margin, default fund, CCP capital) under a member default, and size the margin needed for a target cover.

modules.title: Household Finance & Wealth Management
modules.core: Household balance sheets, lifecycle saving, retirement accounts and taxes, asset location, the evidence on household investment mistakes, financial literacy, advice and fees.

project.title: Retirement plan with Monte Carlo
project.brief: Build a household financial plan with block-bootstrap Monte Carlo withdrawal sustainability (embedded Shiller data) and tax-aware asset location, and write the client letter explaining the risks in plain language.

modules.title: Bond Math & Curve Construction
modules.core: Pricing, yield conventions, day counts, duration, convexity, DV01, bootstrapping, Nelson–Siegel and Svensson, the GSW curve.

project.title: Atlas A5: curve engine
project.brief: Add bootstrapping, NS / Svensson fitting and full day-count support to Atlas, tested against published GSW parameters.

modules.title: Term-Structure Models
modules.core: Short-rate models (Vasicek, CIR), the affine class, HJM, the LIBOR market model, calibration.
introduces: Kalman-filter maximum-likelihood estimation of affine models

project.title: Affine model calibration
project.brief: Calibrate a three-factor Gaussian affine model to the historical curve by Kalman-filter MLE, and validate its pricing errors and factor dynamics.

modules.title: Bond Risk Premia & the Expectations Hypothesis
modules.core: Failure of the expectations hypothesis, forward-rate regressions, the Cochrane–Piazzesi factor, model-based term premia, robustness debates.
introduces: Expectations hypothesis of the term structure

project.title: Atlas A13: term-premium and rates-RV module
project.brief: Add ACM-style term premium, carry and roll-down analytics, and curve-trade P&L attribution to Atlas.

modules.debate: Are excess bond returns predictable out of sample?

modules.title: Money Markets & Plumbing
modules.core: Repo, SOFR, reserves and the Fed balance sheet, the Treasury basis trade, dealer balance-sheet constraints, the SLR, the March 2020 dash for cash.
introduces: Central-bank balance sheet (reserves, reverse repo, TGA)

project.title: Plumbing monitor
project.brief: Track reserves, the reverse-repo facility, TGA, repo spreads and swap spreads from public data, and write a mechanism-level explanation of one stress episode.

modules.title: Inflation-Linked Markets
modules.core: TIPS mechanics, breakevens, inflation and liquidity premia, the TIPS–Treasury puzzle.

project.title: Inflation-expectations decomposition
project.brief: Decompose breakevens into expected inflation, inflation risk premium and liquidity premium using a published-model approach on public data.

modules.title: Interest-Rate Derivatives
modules.core: Swaps, caps and floors, swaptions, Black-76, the Bachelier model, SABR, multi-curve discounting, the LIBOR-to-SOFR transition.

project.title: Swaption-cube engine
project.brief: Calibrate SABR per expiry and tenor to an embedded vol snapshot, enforce arbitrage checks, and price off-grid swaptions.

modules.title: Mean-Variance, CAPM, ICAPM & APT
modules.core: Portfolio choice, two-fund separation, CAPM derivation, the Roll critique, ICAPM, APT, the empirical failure of the CAPM.
introduces: The empirically flat security market line

project.title: CAPM on trial
project.brief: Test the CAPM with time-series and cross-sectional methods on open data, and write the verdict with the Roll critique addressed.

modules.title: No-Arbitrage & the Stochastic Discount Factor
modules.core: Law of one price, the fundamental theorem of asset pricing, state prices, p = E[mx], existence and uniqueness of the SDF, mean-variance frontier geometry in SDF terms.
introduces: Existence and uniqueness of the SDF
Minimum-variance SDF in the payoff space
Arbitrage detection as a linear program

project.title: SDF recovery
project.brief: Recover the minimum-variance SDF from a set of test assets, verify that it prices them, and show its out-of-sample pricing errors.

modules.title: Consumption-Based Pricing & Its Puzzles
modules.core: The Lucas tree, the consumption CAPM, Hansen–Singleton GMM, the equity-premium and risk-free-rate puzzles, Hansen–Jagannathan bounds.
introduces: GMM estimation of consumption Euler equations

project.title: Euler-equation GMM
project.brief: Estimate the CCAPM Euler equations by GMM on embedded data, run the J-test, and interpret the rejection.

modules.title: Resolving the Puzzles
modules.core: External habit, long-run risk, rare disasters, heterogeneous-agent models, and which survive the data.
introduces: Evaluating models on matched data moments

project.title: Model horse race
project.brief: Simulate the three canonical models under their published calibrations and score them on the same twelve data moments, out of sample where possible.

modules.debate: Is the equity premium a risk premium?

modules.title: Present Value & Return Predictability
modules.core: Excess volatility, the Campbell–Shiller decomposition, dividend-price regressions, the out-of-sample predictability debate, discount-rate variation.

project.title: Variance decomposition
project.brief: Decompose dividend-yield variance into cash-flow and discount-rate news with a VAR, and test sensitivity to sample and specification.

modules.title: Intermediary & Institutional Asset Pricing
modules.core: Limits to arbitrage, intermediary capital as the marginal investor, slow-moving capital, demand-system asset pricing, inelastic markets.
introduces: Intermediary capital as the marginal investor

project.title: Flow-impact estimation
project.brief: Estimate price impact of index inclusion flows from a constructed event set (bring-your-own-data), and relate the multiplier to the inelastic-markets prediction.

modules.title: Behavioral Finance
